# LayoutLM document-QA E2E notebook — fleet-sweep fixes

**Source:** the 2026-10-05 static fleet sweep of `main` flagged this notebook for the old restart guard and a missing
guided layer (0 of 9 guided markers; declares `GUIDED`). While in the same cells, two quality `assert`s, a frozen-model
re-run defect and Colab-only BYOD were found and fixed. This is a targeted fix; **no full Notebook Review Framework v1
review has been done**.
**Base:** `main` at `9c5ccfd`.
**Notebook:** `tutorials/layoutlm_document_qa_colab.ipynb`, regenerated by `tools/build_notebook.py` (`build_notebook.py/2.2`).
The workshop and capstone notebooks use their own generators (already isolated) and are untouched; `build_receipt_capstone.py --check` passes.
**Readiness:** **Verification pending.** **Status labels:** unchanged (the release-verification status text is left for the maintainer).

## User-visible changes

- Isolated Section 1 (`dimer_isolated_env_<lock digest>/`); no install into the kernel, no restart; Linux x86_64 only.
  New file `tutorials/requirements-colab.lock.txt`.
- Sections 6 and 8 print verdicts instead of stopping on a weaker result; `comparison` gains `verdicts`.
- Re-running Section 6 or 7 reloads the frozen model first (printed).
- Section 4 gains `BYOD_PATH`; BYOD errors name the file.
- Guided-layer markdown; the closing gains Troubleshooting, Change one thing, Glossary, Conclusion.
